say:1:1430124401:1.text: I'm not sure. Before, besides being an overseer, I was also responsible for looking after the echorite mining area...
say:1:1430124401:1.source_cn: 我也不知道，之前我除了监工，还负责掩盖深岩晶矿区的情况……

say:2:1430124402:1.text: But some time ago, a lot of people saw the dragon flying away. Sooner or later, the truth about the echorite will be revealed.
say:2:1430124402:1.source_cn: 可前阵子很多人都看见龙从地下飞走，深岩晶的真相早晚都会...
